ii. issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties to convert medical leave of the petitioner for 227 days from the month of June 2022 to the month of December 2022 into earned leave and to pay salary for the aforementioned 227 days with 12% interest.
iii. issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties to convert medical leave of the petitioner for 50 days i.e. 14 days medical leave in the month of September 2021 and 36 days medical leave from September 2023 to October 2023 into earned leave and to pay salary for the aforementioned 50 days with 12% interest......"

5.
